title: Consolidate Python TX queues: delete timing/tx_queue.py, port vector tests to runtime queue
description: Follow-up from b7z9.142 (constant fix + single-sourcing landed there). lichen/timing/tx_queue.py remains a second full TX-queue implementation (sync, 257 lines) alongside the asyncio runtime queue (lichen/link/tx_queue.py, 698 lines) — b7z9.142 single-sourced the deadline/capacity constants so they cannot drift, but the bead's full goal is ONE Python TX queue. Work: port python/tests/timing/test_tx_queue_vectors.py to drive lichen.link.tx_queue (APIs differ: sync TxQueueEntry/callback reservations vs asyncio TxReservation Futures, TxQueueStats naming, constructor signatures), delete lichen/timing/tx_queue.py, and update the vector-test module docstrings. Sized as its own bead: the vector corpus (tx_queue_implementation/bounded/expiry/priority + no_silent_drops TxQueue vectors) must all drive the runtime asyncio queue.
